name: axiom-parser-helper-controls-v2
argv:
import gzip,hashlib,json,re,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
helper=Path('/home/ray/developer/ai/math/audits/2026-10-07-m3-fresh-checkout/check_lean_axioms.py')
historical=Path('/tmp/math-m3-ba0b447/artifacts/c5_integrate_branch_review/logs/lean_axioms.log.gz')
source=Path('/tmp/math-m3-ba0b447/Math/ExcessTwoCertificatesAudit.lean')
control_root=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='math-m3-axiom-helper-controls-'))
text=gzip.decompress(historical.read_bytes()).decode()
pattern=re.compile(r"^'([^']+)' (?:depends on axioms:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]|does not depend on any axioms)",re.MULTILINE)
matches=list(pattern.finditer(text))
assert len(matches)==558
controls={'historical_baseline':text,'missing_first_declaration':text[matches[0].end():].lstrip('\n'),'duplicate_first_declaration':text+'\n'+matches[0].group(0)+'\n','sorry_axon_first_declaration':text.replace('Quot.sound','sorryAx',1),'extra_error_diagnostic':text+'\nMath/ExcessTwoCertificatesAudit.lean:1:0: error: helper control diagnostic\n'}
first_positive=next(m for m in matches if m.group(1).endswith('_positive'))
old=first_positive.group(0)
controls['positive_native_injected']=text[:first_positive.start()]+old[:-1]+', foreign.native_decide.ax_1]'+text[first_positive.end():]
first_rejected=next(m for m in matches if m.group(1).endswith('_rejected'))
old=first_rejected.group(0)
mutated=re.sub(r'\b[^,\s\[\]]*\.native_decide\.[^,\s\[\]]*','foreign.native_decide.ax_1',old)
assert mutated!=old
controls['rejected_foreign_native_replaced']=text[:first_rejected.start()]+mutated+text[first_rejected.end():]
records={}
for name,value in controls.items():
    log=control_root/(name+'.log')
    log.write_text(value)
    output=control_root/(name+'.json')
    run=subprocess.run(['python3',str(helper),'--log',str(log),'--source',str(source),'--output',str(output)],text=True,capture_output=True)
    (control_root/(name+'.stdout')).write_text(run.stdout)
    (control_root/(name+'.stderr')).write_text(run.stderr)
    records[name]={'exit_code':run.returncode,'last_stderr_line':run.stderr.splitlines()[-1] if run.stderr else '', 'output_exists':output.exists()}
assert records['historical_baseline']['exit_code']==0
assert all(records[k]['exit_code']!=0 for k in ('missing_first_declaration','duplicate_first_declaration','sorry_axon_first_declaration','positive_native_injected'))
baseline=json.loads((control_root/'historical_baseline.json').read_text())
print(json.dumps({'scope':'HELPER CONTROLS ONLY: historical Oct05 log and synthetic corruptions; not current LC build or axioms evidence','control_root':str(control_root),'helper_sha256':hashlib.sha256(helper.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'historical_gzip_sha256':hashlib.sha256(historical.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'baseline_groups':baseline['groups'],'baseline_declaration_count':baseline['declaration_count'],'controls':records},sort_keys=True))
